content: UX patterns for residential pages (2026: videinfra, ParallelHQ, EffectLab, magicbricks PDP, Godrej, Bollineni): gallery categorized (exterior/interior/views), interactive floor plan viewer with filter by rooms/area/floor, typology tables (type/area/price/status/'Check Price'), master plan, amenities with icons, nearby-infrastructure map (schools, hospitals, transit with drive times), EMI calculator (illustrative with disclaimer), virtual tour/3D (Matterport: tours sell 31% faster, drone photos +68% sell speed), animated stats counters, sticky enquiry bar. Portal PDP anatomy (magicbricks): Overview, Floor Pricing, Properties, Reviews, About Developer, FAQs, EMI calc. Don't gate plans behind signup; don't hide price.
